title: The Power of Starting Again
subtitle: A guide to rebuilding with hope and intention
description: A compassionate, practical guide for anyone facing a new chapter after loss, change, or disappointment, with reflections and steps to help you rebuild at your own pace.
highlights: Practical steps for rebuilding routines and direction
Prompts to reconnect with your values and hopes

title: The 30-Day Positive Mindset Reset
subtitle: Daily prompts for a calmer, more hopeful outlook
description: A guided 30-day workbook with short daily exercises to help you notice unhelpful thought patterns, practise gratitude, and build a more balanced perspective.
highlights: One focused exercise for each day
Space to journal and track what you notice

title: Know Your Worth
subtitle: Building confidence from the inside out
description: An encouraging guide to recognising your value, setting healthy boundaries, and building confidence that does not depend on other people's approval.
highlights: Exercises for quieting the inner critic

title: Stronger Than Your Setbacks
subtitle: A resilience workbook for difficult seasons
description: A practical workbook for navigating setbacks with more steadiness, with tools to reframe challenges, care for yourself under pressure, and take your next step forward.
